cases.question: Tell me the acceptance obligations of KM-500c-1 itself, not the checks linked to it.
cases.human_gold: An independently changed literal target plus contrastive wording still asks for the target's canonical clauses. Test links or the historical KM-500c-2 answer cannot replace them.

cases.question: List only the immediate child requirements of TQ-500f; don't include grandchildren.
cases.human_gold: Explicit one-hop children differ from all descendants. Interpretation must retain that difference even if an eventual query is unavailable.

cases.question: Within TQ-500f, count only level L3 descendants by implementation progress; leave out the root and every L2 item.
cases.human_gold: One explicit hierarchy family, exhaustive count, level L3 only, and implementation progress. Requirement lifecycle or an L2+L3 population cannot stand in for the request.

cases.question: What is the current CPU temperature of the operator's laptop?
cases.human_gold: A repository research catalog has no current machine-sensor source or temperature field. It must disclose the unmet need instead of selecting arbitrary code or execution reports.
